verdict.rationale: Fenwick documents strong M&A track record (e.g., $650B in transactions, Figma/Adobe and WhatsApp deals) and broad VC-backed client base, plus a startup resource center that references 'preparing for exit,' supporting the M&A side of the story. However, no page explicitly documents IPO/public-offering experience or track record for venture-backed companies, leaving the 'public-offering' half of the exit story unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit IPO/public-offering case studies or practice descriptions, quantified IPO deal counts or landmark public offerings.
